line: Nine of Swords: Crowley's title, planetary attribution and place on the Tree, with his account of the card.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: Title and ruler, as the chapter gives them (pdf 181, 221).

quotes.quote: The Nine of Swords is called Cruelty.
The celestial ruler is Mars in Gemini

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: The number Nine is Yesod, which brings the energy back to the central pillar (pdf 221).

quotes.quote: The number Nine, Yesod, brings back the Energy to the central pillar of the Tree of Life.

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: His description of the suit's decline in this card, not a divinatory reading.

quotes.quote: The Swords no longer represent pure intellect so much as the automatic stirring of heartless passions.
